messages.subject: Shiny too much slow
parts:
Hello, 

I've a Script that takes some minutes when I execute on Rstudio. When I use this same script on Shiny app take hours to finish. The scripts show a lot of warnings, but even if I hide them, Shiny still takes hours. 

Is there any method to avoid this? 

Why this could happen?

Thanks.

messages.author: 28ab8a689f695f3f
messages.subject: Re: Shiny too much slow
parts:
Hi, 

I've solve the problem. The thing was that one function generate hundreds of warning messages. When I run the code on RStudio, just let me know that I can read the warnings. But when I run the code on Shinny server, the server shows warnings one by one and take hours. I've wrap the function that generate the warnings using suppressWarnings(), and it works.

Thanks.
